reasoning_traces.think:
The dual nature of introspection—descriptive (Beschreibung) versus reportative (Kundgabe)—is foundational to cognitive science. The descriptive operator \mathcal{D} maps conscious content \mathcal{C} into a texture space \mathcal{T}, preserving only the immediate phenomenal structure. Conversely, the Kundgabe operator \mathcal{K} maps \mathcal{C} into a meaning space \mathcal{M}, incorporating semantic interpretation. These operators form a duality \mathcal{D} \perp \mathcal{K}, implying mutual exclusivity and orthogonality in cognitive processing. Their failure modes arise from observer bias, semantic contamination, or insufficient training. The epistemic error kernel \epsilon(\mathcal{D}, \mathcal{K}) quantifies the extent to which \mathcal{K} leaks into \mathcal{D} or vice versa. This framework enables Bayesian inference in GSI through \mathbb{P}(\mathcal{D} | \mathcal{K}) and \mathbb{P}(\mathcal{K} | \mathcal{D}), while in GSE, it models state transitions via \dot{\mathcal{S}} = \mathcal{T}(\mathcal{D}, \mathcal{K}).
